values.title: About Me
values.subtitle: More Than a Profession — A Mindset of Continuous Creation
values.card1Text: My journey began with English language teaching, where I discovered the power of communication, structured learning, and making complex ideas easier to understand.
values.card2Text: I build digital experiences that communicate clearly, make information easier to understand, and help people learn, explore, and interact.
values.card3Text: I design information-rich visuals, create interactive educational lessons, and experiment with AI-powered solutions.

projects.title: Selected Work
projects.subtitle: Turning Ideas Into Digital Experiences — A selection of projects reflecting my interests across education, web development, and creative design.

footerCTA.title: Teach. Build. Create.
footerCTA.subtitle: Technology is a tool. Creativity is a perspective. Education is a purpose.

contact.title: Let's Collaborate
contact.subtitle: Whether you need a website, an interactive educational experience, a compelling visual presentation, or a creative digital solution, I'd love to hear what you're working on. Let's turn your ideas into something purposeful, engaging, and real.
